title: SciDev: $8M MaxiFlox Contracts Awarded
caption:
The Announcement Room | SciDev Limited (SDV)

SciDev Limited announced three MaxiFlox chemistry contracts with a total committed value of about $8 million, across mining, utilities and infrastructure. The company says each contract followed a competitive tender and expects about $5 million of revenue from them in FY27, of which about $3 million is incremental to FY26.

The announcement follows a weaker FY26, when revenue fell to $85.5 million from $103.4 million and underlying EBITDA fell to $3.6 million from $7.1 million. Recurring revenue rose to 38% of FY26 revenue from 30%.

Key points:
• Three contracts, about $8 million total committed value
• Initial terms of about one to three years
• Extension options worth up to about $4 million, or about $12 million if all are exercised
• About $5 million of FY27 revenue expected, a company expectation and not a result
• About $14 million of new chemistry contracts in calendar 2026, including the $6 million Newmont contract
• FY26 net cash of $6.8 million at 30 June 2026

Looking ahead, the extra $4 million depends on customers exercising options, and the FY27 revenue is an estimate. The company has not disclosed contract margins.

In this two-page investor report, we look at:
• What the three contracts cover
• How the contract value compares with FY26 results
• Why the $5 million FY27 expectation is small against group revenue
• What investors should watch next
